Form input elements produce readable output without form mechanics

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<form><label for="name">Name:</label><input type="text" id="name" placeholder="Enter name"></form>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(preprocessing: HtmlToMarkdown::PreprocessingOptions.new(remove_forms: false)))
puts result.content.inspect
```
